  • Secured Shopping & Payment

    Our website is secure and complies with best privacy and security policies. You can pay using Visa, Master Card, American Express, STC's Qitaf, Cash on Delivery or Pay at Showroom

  • Authentic & Warranted Products

    All listed electronics are genuine and warranted by either Jarir Bookstore or the manufacturer for up to three years, excluding accessories or peripherals. T&C apply.

  • Convenient Returns & Support Services

    You can return or exchange your purchases the way you prefer. Visit the nearest Jarir Bookstore showroom or simply contact us and we will serve you wherever you are in Saudi Arabia.

  • Fast Delivery

    We deliver across Saudi Arabia within 1-3 days to major cities and within a maximum of 5 days to other cities.
